The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] launched a series of '''attacks''' on [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial forces]] in [[3 ABY]] as they attempted to construct the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[NL-1|Platform NL-1]] in the [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni system]].

==Prelude==
[[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] task force had succeeded in eliminating the [[Pakuuni Pirates]] outpost, establishing a foothold on the [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni system]]. Following the initial attack, Frigate ''[[Ludwick]]'' patrolled the system until [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoys carrying parts and construction crews could arrive to build a new space installation. [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] reported high probability of enemy counter attack.

==The battle==
The ''Ludwick'' deployed two flight groups of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and a group of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] to patrol the system until the convoys arrived. Less than fifteen minutes before to the convoy arrived, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Huntress]]'' emerged from hyperspace, launching [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], rapidly joined by [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] from [[Red Squadron (Y-wing)|Red Squadron]] to bomb run the Frigate ''Ludwick''. Imperial fighters bested the initial fighters fronted by the Rebel Alliance, swiftly replaced by fresh [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]].

Imperial Fighters, one of which piloted by [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], fought vigilantly against the Rebel attack, however their Rebel rocket and torpedo attacks succeeded in heavily damaging the hull of the ''Ludwick''. The ''Huntress'' also got hit to the point of losing shields. Which resulted in two [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Shuttles]] called [[Escape]] carrying [[Officer/Legends|Officers]] leaving the frigate. However, both were destroyed by Maarek while the Frigate prepared to retreat. As the ''Ludwick''{{'s}} condition deteriorated, [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvette]] group ''[[Horvus]]'' arrived, along with [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Stalwart (Victory-class)|''Stalwart'']] and the rest of the convoy, consisting of [[Cargo ferry]] group [[Bakkun]], [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|freighter]] group [[Ravn]] and [[Modular conveyor]] group [[Gorfan]]. With the might of the ''Stalwart'' and its combined task force, Frigate ''Huntress'' fled to the safety of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

[[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] task force had succeeded in eliminating the [[Pakuuni Pirates]] outpost, establishing a foothold on the [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni system]]. Following the initial attack, Frigate ''[[Ludwick]]'' patrolled the system until [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] convoys carrying parts and construction crews could arrive to build a new space installation. [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] reported high probability of enemy counter attack. The ''Ludwick'' deployed two flight groups of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] and a group of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] to patrol the system until the convoys arrived. Less than fifteen minutes before to the convoy arrived, [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]] ''[[Huntress]]'' emerged from hyperspace, launching [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], rapidly joined by [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] from [[Red Squadron (Y-wing)|Red Squadron]] to bomb run the Frigate ''Ludwick''. Imperial fighters bested the initial fighters fronted by the Rebel Alliance, swiftly replaced by fresh [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]].
Unyielding to Imperial presence, Rebel forces staged their first assault on the platform itself with [[A-wing]]s, [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and two [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|''Assassin''-class corvettes]] from group [[Moori]]. With shields functioning at only fifty percent, Platform NL-1 stood severely exposed to the impending Rebel assault. Imperial [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|gunboats]], [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]], and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] from Frigate ''[[Ludwick]]'' rapidly found themselves engulfed in combat against Y-wings, A-wing and the newly arrived [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]]. A portion of assault gunboat group [[Tau]] destroyed Corvette ''Moori'', resulting in the arrival of Shuttle ''[[Shakker]]''. Prior to the attack, [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order]] agents had requested that their trusted pilot, [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], arrange for the capture of such escape craft, in the hopes of extracting vital information concerning Rebel plans in the system. Stele himself saw to the identification of the ''Shakker'', escaping from Moori and its subsequent disabling. Transport ''[[Soryi]]'' launched from NL-1 to capture the officers found aboard. As Imperial fighters whittled down the remaining rebel forces [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transports]] from group [[Del (Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport)|Del]] arrived to attempt another futile torpedo run on the platform, only to be destroyed. With the capture of Shuttle ''Shakker'', and [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Stalwart (Victory-class)|''Stalwart'']]{{'s}} arrival from hyperspace, it was not long before the destruction of the remaining Rebel forces.

[[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]], at the time, [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] was anxious to inspect the work of his subordinates on [[Space station]] [[NL-1]]. Much of Frigate Ludwick's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|Interceptor]] stores could not be fielded as a fighter screen during Thrawn's inspection, due to repair and refurbishing necessities; thus the Ludwick would suffice with heavily armed TIE Bombers to oversee the Vice Admiral's visit. [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] expected trouble but had no intel.

Thrawn and his staff ferried from his command ship, the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Stalwart (Victory-class)|''Stalwart'']] to NL-1 aboard Transports Sigma. No sooner had Thrawn begun his journey to NL-1 an attack composed of Rebel [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]], [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] arrived. Imperial fighters moved to intercept as Thrawn's inspection team boarded the platform. Imperial pilots, one of which was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], managed to finish off this low level hit and run just as Admiral Thrawn completed his inspection, returning to the Stalwart aboard Transport [[Omega]]. Moments after Imperial TIE Bombers moved to escort Thrawn back to the Stalwart, several groups of [[Pakuuni Pirates|pirate]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] arrived to add the disruption. Thrawn safely arrived aboard his vessel as Imperial fighters suppressed the last of the rebel and pirate nuisance.

The skirmish was considered a close call for Thrawn's safety. He was impressed by Stele's performance in a TIE Bomber in a role it was not designed to do. With the inspection complete Thrawn decided to make preparations to finalise the station and bring the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]] under Imperial control.

With the [[space station]] [[NL-1]]'s construction completed and inspected by then [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], there were just the finishing touches to make the station fully operational. His [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Stalwart (Victory-class)|''Stalwart'']] stayed on station for the last critical steps of the station construction effort. Two [[Patrol ship/Legends|System patrol craft]] designated [[Ranger (IPV-1 System Patrol Craft)|''Ranger'']] arrived not longer after the previous enemy engagement. The ''Stalwart'' was soon to depart the system to bring reinforcements to aid the arrival of relief for the battle-weary [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Ludwick]]''. Knowing that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] were likely to stage one last effort to disrupt [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control of the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]], members of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order]] tasked their pilot, [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], to be alert for any craft carrying high priority targets in the hope to gather more information about Rebel activity.

In the absence of a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], patrol frequency increased and pilots aboard the ''Ludwick'' anticipated additional enemy activity. Sure enough, the Rebels attacked, starting with the arrival of the [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|assault transport]] [[Thunder (Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport)|''Thunder'']], accompanied by [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]], the rebels' more advanced assault craft. Escorting [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|assault gunboats]], [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bombers]] and [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|interceptors]] moved to intercept, followed by the launch of a suspicious [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] from the Rebel assault transport. Maarek Stele, piloting an assault gunboat, inspected and disabled the shuttle ''[[Electra]]'', which was revealed to be carrying Rebel advisors. During the battle, more Rebel forces arrived aboard the [[Rover (transport group)|Rover]] group, along with [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] and [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing fighters]]. Transport [[Shark (transport)|''Shark'']], dispatched to capture Shuttle ''Electra'', succeeded in its mission even amidst the heavy fighting. The Rebel onslaught heavily taxed Imperial pilot abilities, and inflicted heavy damage to station NL-1 and patrol craft ''Ranger''. Despite this, Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] wrestled the upper hand from the imposing rebels, just as the ''Stalwart'' arrived with the frigate ''[[Gaarni]]'', [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Stallion]]'' and supplies aboard bulk freighters ''[[Sivaa]]'' to relieve the ''Ludwick''.

==Aftermath==
Thrawn oversaw the repairs of NL-1, anxiously wanting the station fully operational and prepared for any further Rebel attack, keeping everyone involved on a hasty schedule. With the Station fully installed, operational and reinforced, the Rebels and the Pakuuni pirates had been completely driven off and the Imperial control over the sector, allowing intergalactic trade to flourish and benefit the Empire. For his efforts, Stele was awarded the [[Medal of Progress]].

Stele was also given the next rank in the Secret Order of the Empire for capturing the Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]], allowing more information about Rebel activity in the sector. However, he would not follow through with what they would find. Instead, he was transferred to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] frigate ''[[Shamus]]'' to help him [[Battle of Mylok IV|acquire]] new [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]] technology.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle appears in the PC Game [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], as the majority of the third Battle mission. This article assumes "Medium" difficulty. In "Hard" difficulty not only are there are more fighters to contend with, the player has to destroy another Assassin-class corvette group [[Runeer]].
